fields.title: PHASE 3 — The Picture 10 Years Out: 3 Scenarios (2036, $1 billion units) — Recalculated
fields.md:
**Baseline replaced**: The September issue started from 2Q26 annualized revenue of $31.3 billion. This issue starts from **3Q26 annualized revenue of $58.3 billion (= 14,575 × 4)**. AI annualized $30.2 billion · Connectivity $21.0 billion · Space $7.1 billion.

| Item | Bull (P=25%) | Base (P=50%) | Bear (P=25%) |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| Connectivity revenue | 190 | 140 | 75 |
| Space revenue | 35 | 25 | 15 |
| AI revenue | 480 | 160 | 40 |
| **Total revenue** | **705** | **325** | **130** |
| Operating income | 229 | 91 | 13 |
| Operating margin | 32% | 28% | 10% |
| Net income | 167 | 60 | ~0 |
| FCF | 130 | 45 | (5) |
| Segment mix (revenue) | AI 68 / Conn 27 / Space 5 | Conn 43 / AI 49 / Space 8 | Conn 58 / AI 31 / Space 11 |
| Net debt | 250 | 180 | 200 |

(Source: estimates built from the PHASE 1 measured figures in this report. Probabilities apply Rule 1 of Section 0-3.)

**Cells that changed by more than 20% versus the previous issue, and why** (formula: this value ÷ September value − 1)
- Base AI revenue 130 → **160 (+23%)**: The baseline AI annualized revenue tripled from $10.2 billion to $30.2 billion. The Base scenario's premises (expansion stalls at 8GW, revenue per GW falls from $15 billion to $12 billion) are kept, but the starting point is higher: 8GW × $12 billion = $96 billion + software (Grok·Cursor·API) $64 billion = $160 billion. The September figure of $130 billion was tied to an incorrect measurement of $6.3 billion per GW.
- Bear AI revenue 30 → **40 (+33%)**: Same formula, same reason. The premises of non-renewal of contracts and impairment in 2029 are kept.
- Base total revenue 295 → 325 (+10%), operating income 82 → 91 (+11%), net income 54 → 60 (+11%): Knock-on effect of the AI change (formula: operating margin held at 28%). Under 20%.

**Bull (25%)** — one-line rationale (source: 1-4 measurements and milestone table): Annual revenue per GW of $15 billion holds for two or more quarters (C-2027-2), expansion of 13GW or more by end-2027 is confirmed on actual nameplates, and Ship recovery succeeds from Flight 15 onward. Required milestones: C-2027-1·C-2027-2·B-2027-1·D-2030-1.
**Base (50%)** — one-line rationale (source: 1-2 ARPU trend·1-4 GW measurements): Starlink proceeds as planned but ARPU returns to the $50s, and AI hits price declines in the 2028–2029 contract renewal window and stops expanding at 8GW. Required milestones: A-2028-1, D-2029-1, C-2028-1 **annual basis missed**.
**Bear (25%)** — one-line rationale (source: 1-4 customer concentration·1-5 financing reports·1-6 merger): The counterparty representing 51% customer concentration (Google can terminate on 90 days' notice) departs in 2027–2029, the $40 billion financing settles at rates in the 8% range, and dilution from the Tesla merger compounds. Required milestones: C-2029-1 missed + D-2027-1 missed (equity raise) + B-2028-1 missed.

**Probability adjustment rules (pre-committed, unchanged — Rule 1 is exhausted)** (source: `state.probability_adjustment_rules`)

| Condition | Adjustment | Status |
|---|---|---|
| 3Q26/4Q26 annual revenue per GW above $10 billion | Bull +5, Bear −5 | **Triggered (2026-10, exhausted)** |
| Ship recovery succeeds by 2027-06 | Bull +5, Bear −5 | Pending |
| Equity raise within 2027 (including convertible bonds) | Bear +10, Bull −5 | Pending |
| ARPU below $60 for 2 consecutive quarters | Bear +5, Base −5 | Pending (currently $69) |
| Kuiper has not launched a US consumer plan by end-2027 | Base +5, Bear −5 | Pending |
| 2029 renewal confirmed for top 2 AI customers | Bull +10, Bear −10 | Pending |
| 3 consecutive misses on the same axis | Full recalculation | Not applicable |
